title: Return policy
content: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original packaging. Refunds are sent to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the item.

title: Shipping times
content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders are processed within 24 hours on working days.

title: International shipping
content: We ship to most countries. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days and customs fees are paid by the customer.

title: Payment methods
content: We accept credit cards, debit cards and PayPal. Payment is charged when the order is confirmed.

title: Order cancellation
content: You can cancel an order before it is shipped. Once an order has shipped it cannot be cancelled, but you can return it after delivery.

title: Damaged or wrong products
content: If a product arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, contact us within 7 days with a photo. We will send a replacement or a full refund.

title: Warranty
content: Electronic products have a one year warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage.

title: Order tracking
content: After your order ships you receive a tracking number by email. You can also ask the assistant for the status of an order using the order number.

title: Support hours
content: Our support team is available Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 17:00. Complex cases are transferred to a human agent.
